packageRules.description: Update the cf CLI, the Astro Cloudflare adapter and the Cloudflare Vite plugin in one PR. Their beta releases depend on each other.

Pin <4.3.0: 4.3.x breaks the rolldown-vite build (`Missing field tsconfigPaths on BindingViteResolvePluginConfig.resolveOptions`). Tracking: withastro/astro#16542. Unpin once @tailwindcss/vite passes tsconfigPaths to vite's createIdResolver.

Pin <7: typescript@7 is the native port. Its root export ships only `version`/`versionMajorMinor`; the compiler API moved to `typescript/unstable/*`. @astrojs/language-server (via @astrojs/check) calls `ts.sys.fileExists`, so `astro check` dies with `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'fileExists')`. Unpin once @astrojs/language-server targets the TS 7 API.
